Shams 1 in Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) is a prime location known for its stunning beachfront views and vibrant community atmosphere. The area boasts a blend of luxury living and leisure, with a variety of upscale restaurants, shops, and entertainment options just steps away. Residents can enjoy direct access to the beach, as well as stunning views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Dubai skyline.

Jumeirah Beach Residence is recognizable with sand color buildings, artistically decorated by street artists to ensure additional charm. This community is in high demand due to its location and its numerous leisure and entertainment options.
